title: Releasing the Inner Jev: A Simple Recipe for Open Decision Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.17205v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based decision-making systems, also called System One models, have recently gained popularity, most notably through Jev (Almeida, 2026). Given a typed input state, a question, and a set of options, they return a probability for each option in a single forward pass, without text generation. We show that existing open instruction-tuned language models can achieve comparable performance \textit{without any additional training}, by reading out answers from letters (A, B, C, etc.) in the model's output logits at the last token position. Furthermore, we show how a simple supervised fine-tuning recipe can improve their performance further. We evaluate four open instruction-tuned language models: Gemma 4 31B, Gemma 4 12B, Qwen3.6-27B, and Qwen3.5-4B. We fine-tune each using LoRA and a decision head initialized from a slice of the language model head. Furthermore, we introduce OpenDecisions, a novel 2,352-question validation dataset designed

translated_title: 释放内在的Jev：开放决策模型的简单配方
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的决策系统，也称为“系统一”模型，近来广受欢迎，其中最著名的是Jev（Almeida, 2026）。给定一个类型化的输入状态、一个问题和一组选项，这类模型在单次前向传播中返回每个选项的概率，而无需进行文本生成。我们证明，现有的开放指令微调语言模型在**不做任何额外训练**的情况下也能取得可比的性能，方法是在最后一个token位置上，从模型输出logits中的字母（A、B、C等）读取答案。此外，我们还展示了一种简单的监督微调配方可以进一步提升其性能。我们评估了四个开放指令微调语言模型：Gemma 4 31B、Gemma 4 12B、Qwen3.6-27B和Qwen3.5-4B。我们使用LoRA以及一个从语言模型头切片初始化的决策头对每个模型进行微调。此外，我们推出了OpenDecisions，一个新颖的包含2,352个问题的验证数据集，旨在……
tldr: 该论文证明现有开放指令微调大语言模型无需任何额外训练，即可通过读取最后一个token位置logits中的选项字母，实现与Jev相当的单次前向传播决策能力，并借助LoRA微调加决策头的简单配方进一步提升性能，同时发布了包含2,352个问题的OpenDecisions验证数据集。
en_tdlr: Existing open instruction-tuned LLMs can achieve Jev-like System One decision-making without any additional training by reading option letters from last-token logits, and a simple LoRA-based fine-tuning recipe with a decision head further boosts performance, accompanied by the new 2,352-question OpenDecisions validation dataset.
